title: Places on wide screens: a sidebar beside the list and the note, saved searches and pins
steps: On a laptop (840px or wider), Places is a column on the left: Feed, Search, Today, Tasks, Calendar; your pinned notes; saved searches with how many notes each finds; and Sources, Archive, Trash, Extensions and Settings at the bottom.
Click Tours under Saved searches: the list beside the note shows the notes it finds. Click one: it opens beside the list. Click Feed to have every note listed again.
Press ⌘K (Ctrl+K), type launch, and press ⌘S (Ctrl+S): name it, and it's a place, in .common-ink/places.json. Hover it and press × to remove it.
Click outside a note, then press g and t: Tasks. g x is Trash, g c Calendar, g d Today, g , Settings. In a note g stays Vim's.
Press ⌘B (Ctrl+B) to put Places away, and again to bring it back. With focus in it, j and k move and Enter opens.
On a phone nothing changes: Places is the sheet from the bottom bar.
